games.title: Slope
games.blurb: One wrong move and it's over. Slope is the ultimate test of reflexes, focus, and patience. Simple concept. Endless frustration.
games.annotation: IT LOOKS SIMPLE... BUT IT ISN'T.
games.subtitle: FASTER. STEEPER. NO BRAKES.
games.description: One wrong move and it is over. Slope is the ultimate test of reflexes, focus, and patience. Simple concept: steer a rolling sphere down an infinite, descending wireframe polygonal trench at breakneck velocity. Endless frustration, zero mercy.
games.controls: [A / D] or [← / →] to Steer · [SPACE] to Restart · Mouse / Touch Supported
games.cheatCode: HOLD [SPACE] ON DROP: Pre-aligning the gyro right as you cross the threshold prevents airborne drift on the first 3 descent ramps.

games.title: Subway Surfers
games.subtitle: THE TRANSIT OFFICER IS RIGHT BEHIND YOU.
games.description: Sprinting through rusted subway yards, dodging oncoming commuter trains, and leaping over caution barriers with freshly tagged boomboxes. High-speed kinetic evasion that tests peripheral vision and tunnel reflexes.
games.controls: [← / →] Change Lane · [↑] Vault / Jump · [↓] Roll Under Barriers
games.cheatCode: DOUBLE-TAP ROLL: Rolling immediately upon touching down after an elevated train vault cancels landing lag and keeps multiplier at 3x.

games.title: Retro Bowl
games.subtitle: MAKE YOUR OWN NFL ADVENTURE
games.description: Retro-styled American football arcade game and franchise simulator that gives gamers the fast-paced action of classic 8-bit sports titles.
games.controls: [W / A / S / D] or Arrow Keys to Steer Pac-Man
games.cheatCode: PINKY TARGET EXPLOIT: Pinky AI targets exactly 4 tiles ahead of Pac-Man. You can bait Pinky into the long bottom tunnel by facing upward.
